rubrics.justification: Generally matches a very poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerate ICM and TE, but it incorrectly states expansion grade 1 means <50% cavity; the provided Gardner 1 indicates an early blastocyst and some visual details are somewhat overinterpreted.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and first-cycle status reasonably well, though some links (stress, sedentary lifestyle, former smoking) are more speculative than central.

Reasoning is structured and internally consistent overall, with prognosis appropriately driven by the very poor embryo grade; minor issue is the grading definition error and a few speculative causal inferences.

Mostly aligned in recognizing 1DD as very poor prognosis and counseling accordingly, but recommending not to transfer as a general rule and suggesting IMSI/PICSI are stronger than guideline-supported evidence; the expansion-grade definition is also inaccurate.

Provides clear options for transfer versus continued culture and future workup, including counseling and male-factor evaluation, though some recommendations are not strongly evidence-based and the final section is truncated.
